reason: Effect::DraftFromSpellbook replaces random: bool with selection: SpellbookSelection (Draft | Chosen | Random). Payloads written before this change still decode (random true → Random, false or absent → Chosen), but a previous build ignores selection and resolves every draft as a whole-book choice, and a draft's WaitingFor::SpellbookDraft now offers three random spellbook entries, redacted for other viewers. First contact must refuse the skew.
